title: Coast Guard responds to disabled catamaran approximately 265 miles off Bermuda
description: Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City responded to a disabled 50-foot catamaran, the Serenity, which was taking on water Nov. 10, 2024, approximately 265 miles off the shores of Bermuda. The Coast Guard coordinated with the cruise ship Treasure, the closest ship to the vessel, who launched a life boat and rescued all four passengers aboard. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City)
